tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for joining us today. We’re excited to learn more about you. First, do you have any volunteer experience before? What kind of program did you participate? What did you like about it?
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢你今天参加面试。我们很期待进一步了解你。首先，你之前有过志愿者的经历吗？你参加过什么类型的项目？你喜欢那其中的哪些方面？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Some people prefer to do easiest tasks first while working. Others would like to start with the most difficult tasks. Which do you prefer ans why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。有些人在工作时倾向于先做最简单的任务。另一些人则喜欢从最困难的任务开始。你更喜欢哪一种？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good point. Next, do you agree or disagree that all workers should be required to stop working and retire by age sixty-five?
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得有道理。下一个问题，你同意还是不同意“所有工作者到了六十五岁都应该被要求停止工作、退休”这种观点？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Great. One last question. Some people have one career throughout their lives. Other people do different kinds of work at different points in their lives. Which do you think is better and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：很好。最后一个问题。有些人一生只从事一种职业。另一些人在人生的不同阶段会做不同的工作。你认为哪一种更好？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview
